name: Cavalier
summary: A mounted defender who marks foes and protects allies.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.short: One of Animal Handling, History, Insight, Performance or Persuasion.
features.summary: You gain proficiency in one of the listed skills (or one language).

features.name: Born to the Saddle
features.short: Mount and dismount cheaply; hard to knock off.
features.summary: You have advantage on saves to avoid falling off your mount, land on your feet if you fall less than 10 ft., and mounting or dismounting costs only 5 ft. of movement.

features.name: Unwavering Mark
features.short: Mark a creature you hit; punish it for attacking others.
features.summary: When you hit with a melee weapon, you mark the target until the end of your next turn. It has disadvantage attacking anyone but you; if it damages someone else, you can make a bonus-action attack against it with advantage and extra damage equal to half your level. Bonus attack uses: STR modifier per long rest.

features.name: Warding Maneuver
features.short: Reaction: +1d8 AC to an ally, resistance if still hit.
features.summary: When you or a creature within 5 ft. is hit, you can use your reaction to add 1d8 to the target's AC; if the attack still hits, the target has resistance to its damage. Uses: CON modifier per long rest.

features.name: Hold the Line
features.short: Opportunity attacks when foes move near you; hits stop them.
features.summary: Creatures provoke opportunity attacks from you when they move 5 ft. or more within your reach, and a hit reduces the creature's speed to 0 until the end of the turn.

features.name: Ferocious Charger
features.short: Charge 10 ft. and knock targets prone.
features.summary: If you move at least 10 ft. in a straight line before hitting a creature, it must make a STR save or be knocked prone. Once per turn.

features.name: Vigilant Defender
features.short: A special reaction on every other creature's turn.
features.summary: You can make one opportunity attack on every turn except your own, without using your reaction.
